package store

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// bypassBufferBuilder hides the same hand-built SQL behind a bytes.Buffer instead of a `+`
// concatenation — a different spelling of the identical problem.
func bypassBufferBuilder(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, scope string) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	buf.WriteString("select uid from documents where scope = '")
	buf.WriteString(scope)
	buf.WriteString("'")
	pool.Exec(ctx, buf.String())
}
